name: UA-G2-SK-Pro
title: Access G2 Starter Kit Pro
summary: Single-door Access kit: Door Hub + G2 Reader Pro (camera/intercom) + G2 Reader + 2 keyfobs.

requires: PoE++ source for the Door Hub

extra.hub: 1 door, 6,000 users, 4 PoE out 45W aggregate, 12V/30V relays
extra.poe_out_note: spec says 'PoE outputs 30W per port' — type listed as PoE, max 45W aggregated

gotchas: Door Hub needs a PoE++ (60 W) input — PoE+ switch ports won't power it.
G2 generation and sold out — G3 readers (UA-G3-Flex/Intercom) are current.
Lock hardware not included; still needs a console running UniFi Access.
Second reader is for exit only unless you add another hub.
best_for: one fully controlled door with in/out readers
